title: doftiles
description: Personal dotfiles as a GNU Stow repo: one package per directory, a Makefile deployment with hooks, herbstluftwm as the window manager, and on-deploy as the one-command installer.

content.heading: doftiles - the stow packages
content: doftiles is the dotfiles repository: every top-level directory with dotfile content is a GNU Stow package whose contents mirror $HOME and get symlinked into place with `stow -R -t $HOME <package>`. Deploy selectively with `make deploy` (a TUI that first configures deploy.profile - the session model, features, units and env - then stows what you pick), or one call it all with `make bootstrap`.

content.heading: Packages provided
content: herbstluftwm - THE window manager stack: the autostart (the WM bootstrap + keybinds), the theme (theme, theme.d/titles.theme, reload_theme, winbarctl), the float machinery + focus helpers (hc_focus, hc_floatx, hc_zoom, the maximize family, hc_center/hc_resize/hc_tile/hc_fit_to shims, hc_bounce, hc_peek, hc_full_focus), the generic hc_* and hlwm_* tools, and all systemd user units (herbst, compton, dunst, hc_send-error-daemon, xvfb, x11vnc, novnc).
polybar - .config/polybar (config.ini + polybar.sh + polywins.sh), polyctl, ewmh_labels, the bar control Makefile; the [module/polyframes] section execs the polyframes binary directly.
shell - .bashrcx, .profile, .aliases, .exports, .zshrc, .vim, .taskrc, .my-credentials, the mimeapps/xdg plumbing, and .local/bin (install hooks, firefox wrapper, check-wsl, load-credentials).

on-deploy / herbctl / herbstutil / polyframes - each submodule is its OWN stow package (dots/<pkg>/.local/state/depends/<pkg>.Makefile owns the toolchain/build/link/install recipe; the artifact lands in dots/<pkg>/.local/bin and stow ships it). depends is remnants-only: the on.deploy shim, the per-distro <target>.deploy resolvers and .config/doftiles.conf.

content.heading: How deployment works
content: Every top-level directory with .config/.local content is a stow package; each package target stows it, records it as remembered (in ~/.local/state/doftiles/stowed - machine-local, the stowed set differs per host), and runs its post-stow hook. Hooks needing a running WM are guarded and no-op with a note on headless targets.

make deploy - selective deployment: an interactive run first walks the deploy.profile TUI (distro target, session model, features, units, env) and provisions BEFORE any package is stowed; then a whiptail checklist picks the packages. P="a b" is the fine-grained non-interactive form; PROFILE=skip bypasses the profile TUI.

make install - the single-run chain: configure (the wizard opens only on a clean install / required-file changes / doftiles.conf modifications), preserve (conflict-safe restow), packages install, status. make bootstrap deploys on-deploy alone; make toolchain runs the language assurances; make deps drives the per-package Makefiles.

make update - the pinned-only pull (recorded submodule pins, no --remote) plus an unconditional on-deploy rebuild; NO installs - make update install runs the install step exactly once. make deploy - the TUI profile walk + stow, PROFILE=skip bypasses.

Bare make - restow exactly the remembered subset. The service units needing X stay enabled-but-failed until X exists; the WSL2 host's herbst.service waits for the Windows-side VcXsrv X server to be reachable.

content.heading: The float registers are herbctl verbs
content: The composite mod-bindings that used to be inline herbstluftwm chains in the autostart (or dots helper scripts) are herbctl verbs now - the autostart spawns the compiled binary: ~/.local/bin/herbctl <verb>.

mod-f / float-focus, mod-x / float-yank, mod-ctrl-f / zoom - the float-register state machines (the hc_focus / hc_floatx / hc_zoom ports), and the plain functional verbs for every navigation, split, close and toggle binding.

The full verb table lives in the [herbctl project](/projects/herbctl); the dots-side helpers it delegates to (hc_center, hc_tile, hc_fit_to and the maximize family) are documented in the [polyframes project](/projects/polyframes) - tile/center are polyframes subcommands behind two-line exec shims.

content.heading: The session model
content: deploy.profile declares how the graphical session starts: wsl-systemd (no display manager - hlwm as the systemd user unit herbst.service, DISPLAY localhost:0.0, waiting for the Windows-side X server; the WSL2 host), greetd (a display manager owns the console; bare-OS targets), xinit (startx runs ~/.xinitrc), or nested (hlwm inside the Xvfb framebuffer, shared over VNC and browser noVNC - co-installable with a primary one, and the xrdp feature layers RDP onto the same shared framebuffer).
on-deploy provision reads the profile and installs the per-feature platform services; the profile's units are enabled additively - activating a second profile never disables the first's.
